sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 26

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 26:1
items.html: It is known that BYA, from their root, have only the discernment of the backs of the Partzuf Nekudot of SAG, that is, only the two lower thirds of Tifferet and NHYM, and they have nothing from the discernment of the vessels of the interior, that is, from the discernment of above the Chazeh [chest]. And from this aspect, it was entirely a place of Klipot, since it was already beneath the concluding Malchut that ascended to the place of the Chazeh [chest], which is the Parsa beneath Atzilut. However, after the breaking of the vessels of the seven lower Sefirot of Nekudim, in which front and back were broken — for the vessels from the Chazeh upward of the seven lower Sefirot of Nekudim also fell to BYA and died, and were mixed with their vessels of the back — this mixture caused the place of BYA itself to expand like a complete Partzuf, for it also gained the discernment of the vessels of the interior from the Chazeh upward, called HBD HGT up to the Chazeh [chest], which came to it by reason of the breaking of the vessels of the interior of the seven lower [Sefirot] that fell there, as explained. And Beriah and Yetzirah, up to the Chazeh [chest] of the world of Yetzirah of the present time, are the discernment of the HBD HGT and the vessels of the interior of the place of BYA. And from the Chazeh of Yetzirah downward, which are fourteen Sefirot, are the discernment of the backs of the place of BYA. And after the sin, the four lower [Sefirot] of Yetzirah and the ten Sefirot of Assiyah descended there. Thus, those two lower thirds of Tifferet and NHYM that were initially diminished from the Partzuf Nekudot of SAG to the discernment of empty void, and occupied the place of all three worlds BYA, from the Parsa of Atzilut to this world — now, after the breaking of the vessels, they contracted and descended after the Chazeh [chest] of Yetzirah, and occupy only fourteen Sefirot. And all this was caused by the mixture of the front and back of the seven lower Sefirot of Nekudim, as explained.
